## About
Bluefelt El Paso Card Club is a private and safe place to play poker on North Mesa Street. We run live cash games and tournaments, with billiards and more, and players of every skill level sit down together to play the game we all love.
Guests rate us 5 from 89 Google reviews. One reviewer said it feels like playing in Vegas and like playing with the bros at home. Another likes that we're on the west side, which makes it an easy stop.

## Services
- Live cash games: Sit down at a live cash game with players from all different skill levels.
- Tournaments: Tournament play alongside our cash games.
- Billiards: A game of pool between hands or while you wait for a seat.

## FAQ
Q: Is Bluefelt for players of every skill level?
A: Yes. Players from all different skill levels meet at Bluefelt to play.

Q: How do I hear about specials and events?
A: Sign up with your email on our website and we'll let you know about specials, sales and events.

Q: Can I reach you on WhatsApp?
A: Yes, you can message us on WhatsApp, send us an email, or stop by during business hours.

## What customers say
- "BlueFelt is hands down the best card club in El Paso! The atmosphere is super welcoming, the dealers are professional, and the games are always well-organized. You can tell they care about their players — everything runs smoothly and the staff is really friendly. Whether you’re a regular or just dropping in, it feels like home. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a clean, safe, and exciting place to play poker!" (Valerie T, 5/5)
- "Favorite Poker Club in EP. If you want to feel like you’re playing in Vegas and feel like you’re playing with the bros at home this is your place. Everyone is generally friendly, the beer is cold, the food is good, and the games are exciting." (Erik Villa, 5/5)
- "Best poker room in El Paso by far. Friendliest most customer oriented room on m town. Free rolls to bigger tournaments. Time specials constantly offering promos. Great dealers and staff. Might be the best room in Texas to play." (James Powell, 5/5)
- "Definitely an enjoyable experience. Offering games that are not played at the other houses. For me it's also a matter of convenience being on the west side. I like it. Friendly staff. Knowledgeable too." (Richard Sheraga, 4/5)
- "The staff is friendly, good action on both cash and tourneys however tourneys can start late and blind structure gets very aggressive after rebuys and add ons are over." (Raul Mora, 4/5)
